name: graph-visible-tests
body: A module's tests are discoverable through the code graph. Relocated tests carry a path the graph classifies as test code (a `tests` path segment: `src/<module>/tests.rs` and `tests/**`), so an agent can find the tests for a symbol and select a tier by `code_type` instead of searching a monolithic `main.rs` whose inline tests are classified as `src`. Keeping tests adjacent to their module is also a cohesion choice: the tests live with the code they exercise.
